description: ONLY when the user asks to save, append a sales interaction to the SELECTED project. Do not save a temporary pasted consultation automatically. Preserve exact customer text in customerMessage, AI suggested reply in replyDraft, advice in followUpAdvice, and sentReply ONLY if the user says it was actually sent. occurredAt is the interaction time only if known from the user; omit if unknown, and the server records the actual saved time separately; channel defaults other if unknown. nextFollowUpAt is an explicit agreed reminder with timezone, never an AI-only suggestion. id is a fresh UUID; on timeout read history and reuse the SAME id/payload to avoid duplicates. relatesTo can link a later actual reply/correction to a previous record. Does not send anything, change project status/design/prices or confirm bookings. Return durable receipt.
name: cabinetx_sales_save
title: Save a sales conversation
